title: Exploring mineral–organic interactions for eco-friendly concrete alternatives: a radical concept
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00696H, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Peter Spencer, Hejie Li, Scott Hocknull, Gareth Chalmers, Tianfang Wang
Minerals chelated by organic matter can catalyse the formation of free radicals. These radicals degrade the organic matter, allowing the mineral oxides to bind together and form a rock-like material.
